description: Documented baseline, mapping and synthetic bench log; independent review, applicability and candidate suitability remain open.

brief.title: J12 connector review for Quarry excavator simulator
brief.issue: Prepare a review of a reported J12 link interruption during dust exposure using only the supplied records.
brief.goal: Compare retaining/investigating J12 with evaluating a replacement; identify what evidence the reviewer needs.
brief.constraints: Preserve the sensor signal mapping; other constraints must come from supplied records.
brief.conditions: Synthetic bench context: an excavator sensor-interface simulator.
brief.decision: What is the justified next action before an engineering decision?

sources.name: Quarry excavator simulator — log (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Synthetic dust-chamber note: bench profile DEMO-HEAVY-QUARRY.
The note records 2 interruptions in 10 bench cycles under dust exposure.
The setup, cycle count and result are author-entered synthetic statements; they are not verified measurements.
The bench conditions have not been shown to represent the intended operational environment.

sources.name: Quarry excavator simulator — obs (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Quarry excavator simulator: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in an excavator sensor-interface simulator.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during dust exposure.
This observation alone does not establish a cause or suitability for operational use.

sources.name: Quarry excavator simulator — status (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

An independent engineering review is pending.
Operational applicability of the bench profile is unresolved.

The packet can organize the documented evidence for independent review; it cannot declare release approval.

sources.name: Quarry excavator simulator — req (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Baseline register: Quarry excavator simulator, controller Rev B, harness Rev B.
J12 pin mapping: pin A = signal, pin B = return (invented mapping).
A connector replacement must preserve this mapping. Candidate geometry and materials suitability have not been assessed.
